pr_body: ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? Feature: These changes moves the the BarChart component to `ui/Charts/BarChart` folder, ensures it has the correct types and creates a Storybook component for it. ## What is the current behavior? Partially fixes #6249 [issue link](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues/6249) Currently we've got the BarChart in the `components/to-be-cleaned/Charts/ChartRenderer` file, without proper types and stories. ## What is the new behavior? The BarChart has been moved to `components/ui/charts/BarChart`, with proper types added and stories showing its use with varying props.

issue_context.body:
This issue tracks the component library cleanup. Goal is to eliminate the `components/to-be-cleaned` folder, cleanup `packages/ui`.


Each component needs:
- prop typings (no any)
- storybook 

`packages/ui`, cleanup based on [this PR](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/pull/12427/files):
- [ ] Accordion
- [ ] Alert
- [ ] Badge
- [ ] remove Breadcrumb
- [ ] Button
- [ ] Card
- [ ] Checkbox
- [ ] Collapsible
- [ ] Context Menu
- [ ] Divider
- [ ] Dropdown
- [ ] Form
- [ ] GlassPanel
- [ ] Image
- [ ] Icon
- [ ] IconPanel
- [ ] Input
- [ ] InputNumber
- [ ] remove InputOld
- [ ] remove Introduction and related assets
- [ ] Listbox
- [ ] Loading
- [ ] Menu
- [ ] Popover
- [ ] Radio
- [ ] remove RadioOld
- [ ] Select
- [ ] SidePanel
- [ ] remove Space
- [ ] Tabs
- [ ] Textarea
- [ ] ThemeProvider
- [ ] Toast
- [ ] Toggle
- [ ] Typography
- [ ] remove Spinner
- [ ] remove lib/utilities
- [ ] cleanup lib/theme


Requires in-depth studio code refactoring:
- [ ] ChartsRenderer to split into BarChart and AreaChart under `ui/Charts`
  - [x] AreaChart
  - [ ] BarChart 
    - [x] New component + storybook
    - [ ] Removal of deprecated component
- [ ] TooltipListener hook into `<Tooltip>` component


I will add to the list as we go along.
